verses.text: אוֹיֵ֖ב אֶרְדֹּ֣ף אַשִּׂ֑יג אֲחַלֵּ֣ק שָׁלָ֔ל תִּמְלָאֵ֣מוֹ נַפְשִׁ֔י אָרִ֣יק חַרְבִּ֔י תּוֹרִישֵׁ֖מוֹ יָדִֽי׃
נָשַׁ֥פְתָּ בְרוּחֲךָ֖ כִּסָּ֣מוֹ יָ֑ם צָֽלֲלוּ֙ כַּֽעוֹפֶ֔רֶת בְּמַ֖יִם אַדִּירִֽים׃
מִֽי־כָמֹ֤כָה בָּֽאֵלִם֙ יְהוָ֔ה מִ֚י כָּמֹ֖כָה נֶאְדָּ֣ר בַּקֹּ֑דֶשׁ נוֹרָ֥א תְהִלֹּ֖ת עֹ֥שֵׂה פֶֽלֶא׃
נָחִ֥יתָ בְחַסְדְּךָ֖ עַם־ז֣וּ גָּאָ֑לְתָּ נֵהַ֥לְתָּ בְעָזְּךָ֖ אֶל־נְוֵ֥ה קָדְשֶֽׁךָ׃
שָֽׁמְע֥וּ עַמִּ֖ים יִרְגָּז֑וּן חִ֣יל אָחַ֔ז יֹשְׁבֵ֖י פְּלָֽשֶׁת׃
אָ֤ז נִבְהֲלוּ֙ אַלּוּפֵ֣י אֱד֔וֹם אֵילֵ֣י מוֹאָ֔ב יֹֽאחֲזֵ֖מוֹ רָ֑עַד נָמֹ֕גוּ כֹּ֖ל יֹשְׁבֵ֥י כְנָֽעַן׃
תִּפֹּ֨ל עֲלֵיהֶ֤ם אֵימָ֙תָה֙ וָפַ֔חַד בִּגְדֹ֥ל זְרוֹעֲךָ֖ יִדְּמ֣וּ כָּאָ֑בֶן עַד־יַעֲבֹ֤ר עַמְּךָ֙ יְהוָ֔ה עַד־יַעֲבֹ֖ר עַם־ז֥וּ קָנִֽיתָ׃
תְּבִאֵ֗מוֹ וְתִטָּעֵ֙מוֹ֙ בְּהַ֣ר נַחֲלָֽתְךָ֔ מָכ֧וֹן לְשִׁבְתְּךָ֛ פָּעַ֖לְתָּ יְהוָ֑ה מִקְּדָ֕שׁ אֲדֹנָ֖י כּוֹנְנ֥וּ יָדֶֽיךָ׃
כִּ֣י בָ֣א ס֣וּס פַּרְעֹ֡ה בְּרִכְבּ֣וֹ וּבְפָרָשָׁיו֮ בַּיָּם֒ וַיָּ֧שֶׁב יְהוָ֛ה עֲלֵיהֶ֖ם אֶת־מֵ֣י הַיָּ֑ם. וּבְנֵ֧י יִשְׂרָאֵ֛ל הָלְכ֥וּ בַיַּבָּשָׁ֖ה בְּת֥וֹךְ הַיָּֽם׃

uncertainties.mark: At this crop resolution most accent marks show up as small blobs. I could see where an accent sits, but I often could not tell which accent it is (for example mercha vs tipcha vs munach, zaqef qatan vs gadol, revia, tevir). Treat every accent identification as low-confidence. Vowels and consonants are more reliable.
There is a colon-like double dot right after the final pe, before אַשִּׂ֑יג. It could be a misplaced accent or a printing artifact. I did not transcribe it as punctuation.
I can't confirm an etnach under the shin from the image.
I can't confirm the mark over the shin. It may be a dot from the row above.
I can't tell if the first vowel is holam on the ayin or a hataf/qamats under it.
No dagesh visible in the tav. I'm unsure.
I can't tell the accent above (zaqef or other).
The accent above the alef is unclear (revia?).
I can't confirm darga under the word.

Meteg marks (e.g. צָֽלֲלוּ, כַּֽעוֹפֶרֶת, בָּֽאֵלִם, יֹֽאחֲזֵמוֹ, שָֽׁמְעוּ) are faint. Their presence and placement are uncertain.

observations: Verses 15:9–15:18 (first occurrence) are printed in the song's brick-like gap layout across rows 1–16. 15:19 is printed as running prose on rows 18–19.
Row 16 has a small marginal notation at its left edge, something like יי with dots or a colon below it. It may be a repetition indicator. I could not read it reliably.
15:18 appears twice. The first time (row 16) has יְהוָה with a paseq and the defective spelling לְעֹלָם. The repeat (row 17) has no Divine Name and uses the plene spelling לְעוֹלָם.
In 15:17 the second Divine Name is spelled אֲדֹנָי (alef-dalet-nun-yod). Every other Divine Name in this passage is יְהוָה.
In 15:19 a period is printed after אֶת־מֵי הַיָּם, before וּבְנֵי יִשְׂרָאֵל.
Row 1 starts with אוֹיֵב. אָמַר is not in these images.
